title: Depth 10 -> 12 at constant width 512
description: DEPTH 10->12 and ASPECT_RATIO 48->40 so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; pure depth change, nothing else touched.
reflection: POSITIVE but with clearly diminishing returns: val_bpb 0.986292 vs baseline 0.989007, -0.0027, about 3x the ~0.0009 noise floor. Compare the previous step 8->10 which bought -0.0082. Numbers: params 60.8M -> 71.3M, FLOPs/token 2.96e8 -> 3.46e8 (+17%), total_tokens 381.2M -> 332.8M (-13%), num_steps 2908 -> 2539, steady-state MFU 37.82% -> 38.63%, peak VRAM 27.8 -> 32.9 GB. The marginal gain per depth step fell ~3x while the token cost per step rose, so the depth curve is flattening fast and I would expect depth 14 to be roughly break-even or worse. MFU gained only 0.8pt this time (vs +4.7pt at 8->10), so the free-throughput effect is exhausted too. My prediction of 0.984-0.988 was right but at the pessimistic end. Recommendation for the next round: stop walking depth and move to width (ASPECT_RATIO up so model_dim -> 640 at depth 10 or 12), which is untouched, or revisit a schedule/regularization knob now that the model is no longer obviously under-parameterized.
